notes: Verbatim copy of the Sunbird-RC credential issuance OpenAPI 3.0 document (api-documentation/issue-api.yaml) — complete for that component, which is why it stays the source of truth here. It is a SUBSET of the API the adaptor reaches: Sunbird-RC is multi-component, and the registry entity endpoints the adaptor's generic verbs drive (/api/v1/<entity>) are generated per deployment from the schemas registered there and published only as a per-instance Swagger, so no static document covers them. Known imprecision in the upstream document: credentialResponse types the VC's `type` as a string, while Sunbird-RC (like the W3C VC data model) returns an array.
